CheckTitle: D1 databases should have an external backup strategy
Description: Flags all D1 databases because Cloudflare D1 does not provide automated backups or point-in-time recovery. Operators must implement their own export strategy to protect against data loss from accidental deletion, botched migrations, or platform incidents.
Risk: Without backups, a single bad Worker migration, an accidental DELETE query, or a Cloudflare D1 incident could result in permanent data loss. D1 is built on SQLite which has no transaction log shipping or automated snapshot capability.

Code.Other: Create a scheduled Worker (Cron Trigger) that exports the D1 database and uploads the SQL dump to an R2 bucket on a regular schedule (e.g. daily).

Recommendation.Text: Implement a scheduled backup using a Cloudflare Worker with a Cron Trigger. The Worker should call the D1 export REST API and store the resulting SQL file in an R2 bucket with versioning or lifecycle rules. Test restoration periodically.

Notes: This check always FAILs because D1 provides no backup API to confirm. Mute this finding in Prowler once you have confirmed a backup process is in place for each database.
